attribution.note: Zitron endorses the accounting mechanism in his own explanation; the reference to Burry does not make it merely an attributed claim.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves the directional accounting claim. It does not assert a quantified benefit, improper accounting, or an actual GPU lifespan.

contract.note: The ordinary reading about current reported net income is fair. Requiring a separately measured GPU effect and an explicitly named accounting basis adds requirements absent from this general mechanism claim.

evidence.note: This timely company disclosure concerns broader server and networking assets. It illustrates the mechanism but does not isolate GPU effects or constitute an independent finding.
The pre-cutoff accounting textbook directly establishes that longer useful lives reduce annual depreciation expense and increase annual net income. That supports the general mechanism asserted.

reviews.rationale: On the fair ordinary reading, the claim describes an accounting mechanism, which e2 directly supports. GPU-specific financial measurements are unnecessary to establish that directional relationship. The evidence does not establish improper useful-life estimates or actual GPU longevity. No material counterevidence is supplied.
